confront.speaker: Razorbeak Nest
confront.text: The screeching starts before you see them, thin and high and doubled. Two long-beaked shapes shuffle up from a scrape of trampled grass, wings half-spread. Neither bird gives ground. Each keeps one eye on the other.

options._comment: #330 R1: the corusdeer talk-down's shape. Dormant, never remove -- the cull bounty respawns.
options.text: [Basic Command] Crouch low. Give the nest room.
